info.description:
The ChurchTools REST API is the best entry point for developers to access ChurchTools.

**Authentication:** You need to be authorized to use some endpoints. Those endpoints are marked by a gray lock symbol. If you view the documentation, while you are logged into ChurchTools, all requests are already authorized. If you want to authorized a request, you need to provide a `Login Token` as `Authorization` header in the format `Authorization: Login ` or send a valid cookie. You can use the green "Authorize" dialog to enter those details and see how a request would look like in detail.

**Missing Endpoints:** Not all features are yet available by our new REST API. This documentation will grow in the future. We are working hard to add new endpoints with every ChurchTools version. The documentation will always show only those endpoints you can use with your ChurchTools installation.
info.title: ChurchTools REST API

get.description: The master data are the backbone of ChurchTools. This endpoint returns all data for that module to work with. Different endpoints don't include the master data directly but only state the ID for this data and this endpoint provides the data with all its details.

Get all events that meet the given search criteria. It is important to note that the some of the search parameters are mutually exclusive. Most importantly, pagination only works when `from` is used in combination with `direction` (The `to` parameter is ignored in this case). Conversely, when a range is used with `from` and `to`,  `page` and `limit` are ignored. Furthermore, when neither `to` nor `direction` are supplied, a `to` value with the current date plus two months is used. (NB: The `to` parameter is here still *inclusive*, but will be *exclusive* at a future point in time.)

parameters.description: If true, include also canceled events
parameters.name: canceled

get.description: Returns the roster iCal subscription setting for the requested person. If no roster secret exists yet, the endpoint creates one and returns the setting together with the generated iCal URL in `meta.iCalUrl`.

post.description: Creates a new roster iCal subscription secret for the requested person and returns the updated setting plus the generated iCal URL. Existing roster links for that person are replaced by the newly created secret.

parameters.description: Person ID to create a new iCal roster link for.
parameters.name: personId

get.description: Returns all fact values stored for the specified event that are visible to the current user. The response contains the fact definition, event reference, and the saved value for each matching fact.

requestBody.description: Pass the `value` for that fact as payload. For numeric facts the value MUST be a numeric value. For select facts the value MUST be a valid option.

put.description: Update the service requests of an event. The request body must contain an array of service request objects. Each object must contain the serviceId and the count for that service.
Update the specified service request. Supply exactly one non-null assignee: `personId` for an existing person or `name` for an external person. Omit the other field or set it to `null`.

name.description: Name of an external assignee. Supply exactly one non-null value: `name` or `personId`.

personId.description: ID of an existing person. Supply exactly one non-null value: `personId` or `name`.

post.description: Undo the specified service request which was previously accepted or declined.

get.description: Gets all persons that can potentially be assigned to the specified service of an event. The response includes availability information, service history, and conflicts that help decide whether a person is a good candidate for the service request.
get.summary: Get all possible persons for a service

get.description: Gets all persons that can potentially serve in the specified service, independent of a concrete event. Use this endpoint for service-level candidate lists where event-specific availability and conflicts are not needed.
get.summary: Get all possible persons for a service

get.description: Returns all event templates visible to the current user. Event templates contain reusable defaults for creating event data such as services, service groups, facts, notes, and default start time information.

Returns an unpaginated list of non-cancelled events where the person has a valid assignment. Requires the current user to be this person or a super administrator. from defaults to today and is compared strictly to midnight: an event exactly at midnight is excluded, later events that day are included. Results are ordered by event start ascending with no upper date bound. Visible service assignments are always included under eventServices and are not restricted to just this person. eventFiles is present but this endpoint does not load files, so it is empty. meta.count is the number returned.

parameters.description: Lower bound, strictly after midnight on this date. Defaults to today.
parameters.name: from

AppointmentAdditionalCreate.description: An additional occurrence on a calendar date, using the base appointment’s local start time and duration. With isRepeated=true, the recurrence rule also runs from this additional date, for example to add a second weekday to a weekly series.

id.description: ID of the stored recurrence entry.

AppointmentAdditionals.description: Stored additional date for a series.

AppointmentBase.description: Stored calendar appointment defining a single occurrence or a series. id identifies the whole stored appointment; pair it with a local occurrence start date to address a particular occurrence. startDate/endDate are the base occurrence, not necessarily the occurrence currently being displayed. Service-planning events, registration groups, bookings and meeting requests are separate linked resources.

@deprecated.description: Legacy response metadata mapping deprecated property names to their replacements. This is returned by the API and is separate from OpenAPI’s deprecated annotation.

allDay.description: True when the appointment is all-day. The serialized endDate is inclusive.

id.description: ID of the stored appointment or series.

onBehalfOfPid.description: Person on whose behalf the appointment was entered, or null.

signup.description: Registration-group configuration, or null if the appointment has none.

version.description: Revision counter increased by updates; not an input precondition or a per-occurrence ID.

AppointmentDate.description: Use a UTC timestamp for a timed appointment or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day appointment. ChurchTools interprets dates in the installation’s timezone. Seconds on appointment input are discarded.

AppointmentEndDate.description: End of the base occurrence. For timed appointments it must be later than startDate. For all-day appointments this date is inclusive and may equal startDate for a one-day appointment.

AppointmentExceptionCreate.description: Exclude occurrences starting on this local calendar date, including matches generated from additionals.

id.description: ID of the stored recurrence entry.

AppointmentExeptions.description: Stored exclusion date for a series.

AppointmentRepeatFrequency.description: Interval between repetitions; use a positive integer for automatic patterns, for example 2 with repeatId=7 for every two weeks. Irrelevant for once/manual patterns.

AppointmentRepeatId.description: Recurrence pattern: 0 = once, 1 = daily, 7 = weekly, 31 = monthly by date, 32 = monthly by weekday, 365 = yearly, 999 = manually selected dates. Automatic patterns use repeatFrequency and repeatUntil; manual dates use additionals.

AppointmentRepeatOption.description: For repeatId=32, ordinal of the weekday within the month: 1–5 for first through fifth, 6 for last. The weekday comes from startDate.

AppointmentRepeatUntil.description: Inclusive last date of an automatic series. Supply this with automatic recurrence; omission does not represent an unlimited series in these write endpoints.

AppointmentStartDate.description: Start of the base occurrence. For all-day appointments, send YYYY-MM-DD.

@deprecated.description: Legacy response metadata mapping isPublic and isPrivate to type.

id.description: Calendar ID used in /calendars/{calendarId} and appointment URLs.

isPrivate.description: Legacy category flag: true for personal calendars. Use type instead.

isPublic.description: Legacy category flag: true for church calendars. Use type; this flag does not replace access-permission checks.

nameTranslated.description: Localized display name, falling back to the stored name for ordinary calendar names.

randomUrl.description: Generated token used by calendar subscription/export links. This is not a complete URL and is not the external import source address.

Calendar.description: Calendar containing appointments and their series. Calendar settings, appointment editing and calendar administration are separate concerns. The type selects the applicable administration category; effective visibility depends on permissions. This object is also embedded in appointment responses.

CalendarCreate.description: Create a calendar with its category and settings. The creator receives permission to edit its appointments. Calendar creation does not itself create appointments, except when an iCalSourceUrl initiates a feed import.

CalendarType.description: Calendar category used by ChurchTools: church for a church calendar, group for a group calendar, personal for a personal calendar. The category determines which administration permissions apply; it does not by itself grant public access or link the calendar to a particular group or person. Access is controlled separately. The type is chosen on creation and cannot be changed by PUT.

CalendarUpdate.description: Complete editable calendar settings. name and sortKey are required. Omitted color, campusId, eventTemplateId, iCalSourceUrl and evTermineEventTypeId are cleared; syncToEvTermine defaults to false. The calendar type cannot be changed here. Supplying a non-empty iCalSourceUrl triggers replacement/import of calendar contents, including when saving other settings with the same source URL.

campusId.description: Campus associated with this calendar, or null for no campus. A campus represents a ChurchTools location/site, not a calendar permission group.

color.description: Display color, normally a CSS hex color such as #336699. Omission clears the color; the backend checks only the text length.

evTermineEventTypeId.description: Event type ID used by the Evangelische Termine integration, or null. This is an external event classification, not a ChurchTools calendar type.

eventTemplateId.description: Configured service-planning event template ID for this calendar, or null. This differs from an appointment template.

iCalSourceUrl.description: External iCalendar feed to import, or null for a locally managed calendar. webcal:// and ical:// are normalized to https://; addresses without a scheme receive https://. Saving a non-empty source URL clears existing calendar contents before importing the feed, even when the URL is unchanged. Import and URL errors cause the request to fail.

name.description: Calendar display name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

sortKey.description: Display order. The calendar list is sorted by this value in ascending order.

syncToEvTermine.description: Whether the Evangelische Termine integration should synchronize this calendar. This is separate from importing an iCalendar feed.

ChatStatus.description: Room lifecycle: NOT_STARTED means no started chat, STARTING awaits central-service confirmation, STARTED is active, and STOPPED is deactivated. An accepted request does not guarantee successful Matrix synchronization.

DateString.description: A simple date in ISO format, e.g. '2022-10-19'

DateStringNullable.description: A simple date in ISO format, e.g. '2022-10-19'

DomainObject.description: Compact, domain-independent representation for displaying a link to a ChurchTools object. It is not the full resource returned by the object’s own API.

apiUrl.description: URL for the full API resource, if available. Some legacy domain implementations produce inconsistent URLs.

domainIdentifier.description: Opaque identifier within the domain; do not assume that every domain uses a numeric ID.

infos.description: Additional localized display lines; not structured resource fields.

initials.description: Optional initials for an avatar fallback.

title.description: Display title of the referenced object.

icon.description: user for an ordinary person; user-shield for a censored person placeholder.

Event.description: An occurrence in service planning linked to a calendar appointment. id identifies the planning event, appointmentId the underlying appointment (possibly a recurring series). This enriched read representation differs from the response to PUT /events/{eventId}.

endDate.description: End derived by adding the underlying appointment duration to this event occurrence’s start.

eventServices.description: Assignments included by include=eventServices (legacy spelling). Always included by single-event and person-event reads.

event_services.description: Assignments included by include=event_services. The property spelling follows the requested include.

permissions.description: Computed UI permissions. startChat does not include all installation-level chat prerequisites; the chat action performs its own authorization checks.

EventAssignmentPerson.description: Person representation in an event assignment. A concealed assignee can be represented by a placeholder with icon user-shield; its identifier must not be interpreted as the actual person ID.

EventReadAssignment.description: Visible assignment embedded in an event read response. Uses the legacy assignment representation; concealed assignees may be replaced by a placeholder. List responses normally leave permissions null; single-event responses compute enterSelfIfFree.

comment.description: Legacy comment representation; an absent comment is returned as an empty string.

counter.description: Use index instead. In this legacy response null is converted to 0.

id.description: ID of this particular assignment record. Updating or answering a request may create a new record; use the ID returned by the operation.

index.description: Slot index when an event requires several persons for the same service; null if no index is assigned.

isAccepted.description: Whether this record was confirmed. Interpret together with isValid, as an older confirmed record can be invalid.

isValid.description: Whether this record is still the active assignment for its slot. Superseded and declined records are invalid.

permissions.description: Optional computed assignment permissions. These request endpoints do not populate them and normally return null.

requestedDate.description: Timestamp used by the legacy request history and undo time limit.

serviceId.description: ID of the reusable service role from /services, not the request ID.

EventReadWithServices.description: Enriched event with the eventServices include always present, possibly as an empty list.
